newsitem.title: UK: UK car production rose 9.7% over 6 mths to Jan.
newsitem.headline: UK car production rose 9.7% over 6 mths to Jan.

text.p: Total British car production rose a seasonally adjusted 9.7 percent over the six months to January versus the previous six months, the Office for National Statistics said on Friday.
Production allocated for export rose 18.3 percent while home production rose 0.3 percent.
Compared with the six months a year ago, production was up 18 percent. Production for export rose 40.3 percent on a year earlier. Home production fell by 1.9 percent.
